Name: LaD Zayne's Mod - English Translation
Author: MiscMemos
Description:
[b][size=5]English localization of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40300]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod[/url][/size][/b]

[list]
[*]It includes the complete English localization along with maintenance and compatibility fixes needed for the mod to behave properly on current Stardew Valley 1.6 / Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]The original artwork, maps, music, characters, events, items, recipes, and gameplay belong to the original creator.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[b]This is a standalone content pack, not a translation patch. [/b]

Remove any other copy of the Zayne content pack before installing, including the original Chinese release

[spoiler]Install the required dependencies:
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.3.2+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher 2.8.0+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SpaceCore 1.28.4+[/b][/*]
[*][b]CentralStation 1.7.0+[/b][/*]
[/list]Then place the [b]Zayne_EN[/b] folder in your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/spoiler]

[line]
[heading]Ridgeside Village[/heading]
This version is [b]not compatible with Ridgeside Village[/b] because the two mods use conflicting NPC/festival content.
If you play with RSV, use the separate [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51337%5D%5Bb%5DZayne_ENRSV][b]LaD Zayne's Mod — Ridgeside Village-Compatible English Translation (Zayne_ENRSV[/b][/url][b])[/b] instead.
[line]
[heading]Version 4.2.5[/heading]
This update carries forward a large dialogue and maintenance review of the English release.
[spoiler]Most notably:
[list]
[*]Fixed festival placement/data issues which could prevent Zayne from appearing at festivals as intended.[/*]
[*]Expanded Zayne-specific dialogue coverage and restored missing keys so vanilla/default dialogue is much less likely to take over unexpectedly.[/*]
[*]Improved festival, spouse, gift, rain, movie, mail, and general dialogue handling.[/*]
[*]Corrected additional event, asset-path, animation, and data-format issues found during the review.[/*]
[*]Restored the original TOOL_UPGRADES entry to the TJP shop.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
The detailed technical notes document (download separately) contains the file-level changes and reasoning for anyone who wants the full audit trail.
[line]
[heading]Reporting problems[/heading]
[list]
[*]If you find missing English text, dialogue that clearly belongs to another character, a festival where Zayne doesn't appear correctly, or something else that looks broken, please leave a post or bug report. (If possible, include the relevant SMAPI log and what you were doing when it happened. That makes these much easier to track down.)[/*]
[/list][line]
